messages:
Ava: Quick game—two-line micro-haiku. Line1=weekday mood, Line2=coffee type. I'll start: 'Fog of meetings / oatmilk double-shot.'
Liam: 😂 this is tiny poetry gold
Priya: Match accepted. 'Inbox tsunami / single-origin, black.'
Noah: @Priya savage and poetic
Maya: 'Quiet brain, loud mug / cold brew like a soft drum.'
Liam: All these sound like startup startup startup
Ava: Vote for your fav with an emoji. :1st_place_medal: for Priya, :coffee: for Maya, :sparkles: for Liam
Priya: also, shout-out to @Noah for rescuing the succulents while I was OOO 🙏
Noah: plants are safe. they send their thanks 🌱
DevBot: Reminder: today is casual friday—wear socks with sandals responsibly :socks:
Maya: already on it. socks with sandals = ethical flex
Liam: poll: should office playlist switch to 90s alt or lo-fi? Type '90s' or 'lofi'
Ava: 'lofi'—it's concentration fuel
Noah: '90s' for lunchtime dance micro-break
Priya: fine, compromise: 90s for lunch, lo-fi for deep work
Liam: compromise accepted. winner of workplace diplomacy
Ava: results: lo-fi 3, 90s 2
Maya: tiny poem prize goes to Priya. claim your imaginary trophy <:trophy:>
Priya: i'll accept the trophy and a vitamin D break
Ava: tag me for next micro-poetry round. i'll bring biscotti next time :cookie:
Liam: +1 for biscotti
End of thread.
